proposals.title: Charitable Giving – Recipients, Intents and Benefits
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing standards for charitable recipients, business rationale, personnel involved, societal benefits, and follow-up confirmation of contribution use.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 5.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal
proposals.proponent: Antonio Avian Maldonado, II and Zevin Asset Management
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an accelerated recruitment policy to increase diversity of senior management and board of directors, particularly Hispanic, African American, Native American and other people of color.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 6.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 – Shareholder Proxy Access Amendments
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending proxy access bylaws: nominee cap of 25% of directors or 2, unlimited shareholder aggregation, and no limit on re-nomination based on vote received.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 7.

proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal on Executive Compensation Reform
proposals.topic_summary: Requests engaging multiple outside independent experts or resources from the general public to reform executive compensation principles and practices.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 8.

proposals.title: Proposal 9 – Executives To Retain Significant Stock
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring senior executives to retain 75% of net after-tax equity shares until normal retirement age and prohibiting hedging of such shares.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal No. 9.
